title: Where the Triangle Area Formula Actually Comes From
description: A visual proof that a right triangle is always exactly half of its surrounding rectangle.
narration_lines: Where does the triangle area formula actually come from?
A right triangle is exactly half of that rectangle, cut along the diagonal.
Half of 24 is 12. That's the triangle's area.
